overall_status: No new scoped P1/P2 found after the focus and viewport fixes; this is not a whole-product accessibility pass.
verified: Enter activates the conflict disclosure and reveals additional conflicts.
Keyboard activation of the edit path expands the editor and focuses an available field.
Cancel returns focus to the edit entry point in the component coverage.
When visualViewport returns to window height, mobile navigation is exposed again even if the input remains focused.
When visualViewport is unavailable, focus fallback hides navigation while the keyboard is presumed open and blur restores it.
The 320px layout has no horizontal overflow and decision controls are reachable after scrolling.
minor_test_gap: The Playwright cancel action uses a mouse click; keyboard cancel was not exercised end-to-end.
